title: Phase 3 M3.4 Data Contract Schemas (Verified & Audited)
description: Synthesized from 3 independent audits: (1) Blind Systems Design Auditor — first-principles PMU, nanosecond precision, ISO 26262 failure taxonomy; (2) Repo Ground-Truth Auditor — exact codebase function names, CAN IDs, and frame structures from canfd_schema.py, crypto_engine.py, onnx_inference.py; (3) IEEE/ASAM Browser Auditor — ASAM MDF4, Vector BLF, ACM TECS artifact standards, PQM4 benchmarking norms.
audit_sources: Blind Systems Design Auditor (First-Principles PMU & Fault Taxonomy)
Repo Ground-Truth Contract Auditor (canfd_schema.py, crypto_engine.py, onnx_inference.py, Phase 2 Red Team)
IEEE/ASAM Browser Auditor (ASAM MDF4 v4.2, Vector BLF, ACM TECS, PQM4, ISO 26262-5 Annex D)

perf_stat_summary.purpose: Microarchitectural & OS-level computational resource profiling for cryptographic verification (ML-DSA, Ascon, Kyber) and ML IDS inference (ONNX LSTM) inside Dockerized ECU environments.
standards_compliance: ACM TECS Artifact Evaluation Guidelines (raw counters + derived ratios)
IEEE Micro Microarchitectural Profiling Reporting Norms

benchmark_id.source: IEEE/ASAM Auditor — standard benchmark ID prefix

timestamp_utc.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of benchmark execution

ecu_id.description: ECU role and trust boundary within the CISG architecture
ecu_id.source: Repo Auditor — verified from canfd_schema.py domain segments and handshake_simulation.py node IDs (0x10, 0x20, 0xFF)

container_id.description: Docker container 12-char hex identifier for execution environment tracking

cpu_core_affinity.description: CPU core pinned via taskset/cpuset-cpus to prevent cache invalidation from core migration
cpu_core_affinity.source: Blind Auditor — big.LITTLE asymmetry auditing; IEEE/ASAM Auditor — cpu_migrations must be 0 when pinned

target_arch.description: Target CPU architecture and microarchitecture for reproducibility
target_arch.source: IEEE/ASAM Auditor — PQM4/ACM TECS artifact specification

task_name.description: Canonical string identifier for the profiled cryptographic or ML workload, matched exactly to codebase function names
task_name.source: Repo Auditor — mapped line-by-line to crypto_engine.py (Lines 60-490), canfd_schema.py (Lines 23-905), onnx_inference.py (Lines 111-315), wire_threat_injector.py (Lines 48-80), invariant_threat_injector.py (Lines 43-83)

cache_state.description: Cold-start (first run after cache flush) vs warm (steady-state operational) cache behavior
cache_state.source: Blind Auditor — mixing cold/warm runs corrupts variance analysis

num_trials.description: Number of independent measurement repetitions for statistical confidence
num_trials.source: IEEE/ASAM Auditor — ACM artifact guidelines require N >= 1000 trials

execution_wall_time_ns.description: Wall-clock execution duration in integer nanoseconds. Microsecond resolution introduces 1000x quantization error for sub-us symmetric primitives like Ascon block processing.
execution_wall_time_ns.source: Blind Auditor — corrected from proposed 'execution_wall_time_us'; at 2 GHz, 1 cycle = 0.5 ns

task_clock_ns.description: Actual CPU time scheduled to the benchmark process (excludes preemption idle time)
task_clock_ns.source: Blind Auditor — needed to compute true CPU utilization = task_clock / (wall_clock * N_threads)

cpu_cycles.description: Hardware PMU unhalted core clock cycles elapsed. Canonical denominator for IPC.

instructions.description: Hardware retired instructions at pipeline commit stage. Canonical numerator for IPC.

ipc.description: Derived Instructions Per Cycle = instructions / cpu_cycles
ipc.source: IEEE/ASAM Auditor — ACM TECS standard derived metric, 4 decimal places

cpi.description: Derived Cycles Per Instruction = cpu_cycles / instructions
cpi.source: IEEE/ASAM Auditor — complementary to IPC for stall analysis

branch_instructions.description: Total conditional and unconditional branch instructions executed
branch_instructions.source: Blind Auditor & IEEE/ASAM Auditor — base denominator for branch prediction accuracy

branch_misses.description: Speculative branch mispredictions causing pipeline flushes. Vital for constant-time cryptographic verification (Spectre-type branch target injection, ML-DSA rejection sampling leakage).
branch_misses.source: Blind Auditor — critical for PQC side-channel audit; IEEE/ASAM Auditor — PQM4 standard event

branch_mpki.description: Derived (branch_misses / instructions) * 1000. Standard architectural efficiency metric.
branch_mpki.source: IEEE/ASAM Auditor — ACM TECS / IEEE Micro standard reporting unit

l1_dcache_loads.description: Raw L1 data cache load requests. Mandatory raw divisor for L1-D miss rate.
l1_dcache_loads.source: Blind Auditor — corrected from proposed derived-only 'l1_dcache_miss_pct'; raw counter is canonical

l1_dcache_load_misses.description: Raw L1 data cache misses forcing L2/LLC lookups

l1_dcache_mpki.source: IEEE/ASAM Auditor — standard L1-D efficiency metric

l1_icache_load_misses.description: Instruction cache fetch stalls. Critical for PQC algorithms (ML-DSA polynomial NTT) with large code footprints that exceed 16-32 KiB L1-I caches on ARM Cortex-M7/A53.
l1_icache_load_misses.source: Blind Auditor — L1-D alone cannot reveal instruction-fetch stalls from PQC code size

llc_loads.description: Total memory requests escaping L1/L2 caches to Last-Level Cache (cache-references)

llc_load_misses.description: DRAM memory bus transactions. Detects memory-bandwidth saturation under concurrent ONNX LSTM inference and crypto verification.
llc_load_misses.source: Blind Auditor — L1 miss cannot distinguish 12-cycle L2 hit from 200-cycle DRAM fetch

llc_mpki.source: IEEE/ASAM Auditor — ACM TECS standard LLC efficiency metric

page_faults_minor.description: Virtual memory page allocations in RAM without disk I/O. Reflects ONNX Runtime tensor arena dynamic allocation overhead.
page_faults_minor.source: Blind Auditor — quantifies memory allocation overhead during batch inference

page_faults_major.description: Disk paging events requiring swap I/O. MUST BE 0 in hard real-time automotive ECU evaluation. Non-zero values are fatal for ASIL-D compliance.
page_faults_major.source: Blind Auditor — defense committee will demand proof of zero major page faults

context_switches_voluntary.description: Thread yields due to I/O wait or sleep syscalls

context_switches_involuntary.description: Linux CFS scheduler preemptions. Non-zero values inflate wall_time and depress IPC without reflecting true algorithmic cost.
context_switches_involuntary.source: Blind Auditor — separates OS scheduling noise from crypto/ML runtime cost

cpu_migrations.description: Task hops across CPU cores causing full cache invalidation penalty. Must be 0 when cpu_core_affinity is pinned.
cpu_migrations.source: IEEE/ASAM Auditor — PQM4 requires taskset -c pinning

peak_rss_bytes.description: Maximum Resident Set Size (VmHWM from /proc/[pid]/status or ru_maxrss via getrusage). Expressed in bytes to avoid SI/IEC kibibyte ambiguity.
peak_rss_bytes.source: Blind Auditor — corrected from proposed 'resident_set_size_kb'; bytes eliminates KB/KiB ambiguity

stack_peak_bytes.description: Maximum runtime stack consumption measured via stack canary high-water marks. Standard in PQM4 embedded benchmarks.
stack_peak_bytes.source: IEEE/ASAM Auditor — PQM4 standard stack profiling metric

pmu_scaling_percentage.description: PMU counter multiplexing check (time_enabled / time_running * 100). 100.0 = no multiplexing (clean measurement). ARM Cortex-A53 has only 4-6 PMU registers, so runs with <95% scaling must split into multi-pass profiling.
pmu_scaling_percentage.source: Blind Auditor — leaves PMU overcommit undetected without this field

perf_stat_summary.statistical_aggregation_note: Per IEEE/ASAM Auditor: When num_trials >= 1000, also report mean_cycles, std_cycles, median_cycles, ci95_cycles_low, ci95_cycles_high alongside single-run raw counts for statistical rigor.

tcpdump_latency_summary.purpose: Packet-level wire transit, queuing latency, and jitter tracking across virtual/hardware CAN-FD interfaces, compliant with ASAM MDF4 v4.2 bus logging conventions.
standards_compliance: ASAM MDF4 v4.1/v4.2 (ASAM MCD-2 MC) Master Channel & CAN_DataFrame ChannelGroup
Vector Informatik BLF CAN_FD_MESSAGE struct (uint64 mTime nanoseconds)
Linux SocketCAN SO_TIMESTAMPNS (struct timespec: tv_sec + tv_nsec)
HCRL CAN-FD Intrusion Dataset (IEEE DataPort DOI: 10.21227/gpxq-3551)

session_id.description: Transport session identifier linking all frames in one attestation transfer

frame_idx.description: 0-indexed position within the current burst (0 to 40 for 60/4, 0 to 38 for ISO-TP CF, 0 to 11 for Castiglione native)
frame_idx.source: Repo Auditor — verified from canfd_schema.py:319,341 (indices 0 to 40)

total_frames_expected.description: Expected burst frame count for the protocol (41 for 60/4, 39 for ISO-TP, 12 for Castiglione native, 39 for Castiglione scaled)
total_frames_expected.source: Blind Auditor — needed to validate counter completion

bus_channel.description: Physical or virtual CAN bus interface (1-indexed per ASAM MDF4 CGBLOCK convention)

frame_role.description: Functional role of the frame within the transport protocol
frame_role.source: Blind Auditor — frame_type enum; Repo Auditor — Category 1/2/3 frame types from canfd_schema.py

retransmit_attempt_idx.description: Identifies whether this frame is part of the initial burst (0) or a subsequent retry (1, 2, 3)
retransmit_attempt_idx.source: Blind Auditor — disambiguates initial burst from retransmission rounds

can_id_hex.description: CAN Arbitration Identifier formatted with leading 0x prefix (3 hex digits for standard 11-bit, 8 hex digits for 29-bit extended)

verified_ids.0x046: Castiglione native capsule share (from Base Paper Table 2)
verified_ids.0x047: Castiglione full restart NACK (from Base Paper Section 5.2)
verified_ids.0x201: Selective NACK recovery frame — Gateway_Node/src/main.cpp:150, protocol_fuzzer.py:252

can_id_hex.source: Repo Auditor — cross-referenced across canfd_schema.py, main.cpp, onnx_inference.py; IEEE/ASAM Auditor — ASAM MDF4 + Vector ASC format requires 0x prefix

ide_flag.description: Identifier Extension flag: 0 = 11-bit standard CAN 2.0A, 1 = 29-bit extended CAN 2.0B
ide_flag.source: IEEE/ASAM Auditor — ASAM MDF4 CAN_DataFrame.IDE; ORNL ROAD dataset convention

dlc.description: CAN-FD Data Length Code (0–15). CRITICAL: In CAN-FD, DLC 9-15 map non-linearly to 12, 16, 20, 24, 32, 48, 64 bytes. Must be stored separately from payload_bytes.
dlc.source: IEEE/ASAM Auditor — ISO 11898-1:2015 Clause 8.4.2.3; ASAM MDF4 separates DLC from DataLength

payload_bytes.description: Effective payload length in bytes (non-linear DLC mapping: DLC 10 = 16B for NACK, DLC 15 = 64B for data)
payload_bytes.source: IEEE/ASAM Auditor — ASAM MDF4 CAN_DataFrame.DataLength; Repo Auditor — DLC 15 = 64B for data, DLC 10 = 16B for Cat 3.2 NACK

payload_active_bytes.description: Non-padded active transport payload bytes within the frame (e.g. 60 for 60/4 data frames, 36 for frame 40, 58 for ISO-TP FF, 63 for ISO-TP CF)
payload_active_bytes.source: Blind Auditor — disambiguates padding from active data; Repo Auditor — frame 40 carries 36B active + 24B zero padding

brs_flag.description: Bit Rate Switch flag: 1 = data phase transmitted at fast bitrate, 0 = flat nominal bitrate
brs_flag.source: IEEE/ASAM Auditor — Bosch CAN-FD Spec v1.0 & ISO 11898-1:2015; ASAM MDF4 Flags bitfield

esi_flag.description: Error State Indicator: 0 = Error Active node, 1 = Error Passive node

timestamp_epoch_ns.description: Absolute Unix epoch timestamp at kernel network device driver ingress/egress in integer nanoseconds. uint64 range valid until year 2554. Millisecond representation REJECTED: rounds vcan0 transit times (12-45 us) to 0 ms.
timestamp_epoch_ns.source: Blind Auditor — mathematical proof that float32 epoch_ms has ±131 second error; IEEE/ASAM Auditor — ASAM MDF4 Master Channel & SocketCAN SO_TIMESTAMPNS; Vector BLF mTime is uint64 ns

timestamp_rel_us.description: Elapsed time from first frame of session in microseconds (float64, 2 decimal places for tabular analysis)
timestamp_rel_us.source: IEEE/ASAM Auditor — Vector ASC format uses relative time from session start; convenient for IFAT computation

ifat_us.description: Inter-Frame Arrival Time: delta_t = timestamp_rel_us[k] - timestamp_rel_us[k-1]. Universal timing-based IDS feature across IEEE TVT/TIFS literature.
ifat_us.source: IEEE/ASAM Auditor — ORNL ROAD dataset & IEEE TVT IDS papers; Blind Auditor — detects CAN mailbox buffer overrun risk
ifat_us.nullable_reason: Null for first frame of session (frame_idx = 0)

arrival_jitter_ns.description: Signed deviation from expected pacing interval (rx_ifat - expected_gap). Positive = late, negative = early.
arrival_jitter_ns.source: Blind Auditor — validates ISO-TP ST_min pacing compliance
arrival_jitter_ns.nullable_reason: Null for first frame of session

nominal_baud.source: IEEE/ASAM Auditor — ASAM MDF4 bus parameter; Repo Auditor — 500000 for production, 1000000 for Castiglione baseline

data_baud.description: CAN-FD fast data phase baud rate (only active when brs_flag = 1)

frame_duration_us.description: Physical on-wire transmission time: N_nom * tau_nom + N_dat * tau_dat (including bit-stuffing overhead)
frame_duration_us.source: IEEE/ASAM Auditor — critical for bus utilization and schedulability validation

interface_rx_drops.description: Kernel SocketCAN receive buffer drops (ENOBUFS) sampled from /sys/class/net/<iface>/statistics/rx_dropped
interface_rx_drops.source: Blind Auditor — 41 back-to-back CAN-FD frames can overflow txqueuelen on vcan0

fault_recovery_runs.purpose: Empirical tracking of fault-injection trials, recovery protocol state transitions, selective retransmission rounds, and ISO 26262 failure mode attribution across 3 transport protocols and 3 bitrate regimes.
standards_compliance: AUTOSAR Classic R23-11 E2E Protocol Specification (SWS EndToEndCommunicationProtection)
IEEE TDSC Fault Injection & Dependability Reporting Standards

run_id.description: Unique trial identifier (UUIDv4 or sequential integer)

trial_idx.description: Sequential trial index within a scenario sweep (0 to N_trials-1)

scenario_id.description: Project-defined test scenario ID (1-5 for canonical scenarios, 0 for Monte Carlo sweeps)

bitrate_regime.source: Blind Auditor & IEEE/ASAM Auditor — 3 regimes from transport_simulation_config.json

fault_model.description: Injected fault model classification per ISO 26262-5 Annex D
fault_model.source: Blind Auditor — includes NACK_CONTROL_FRAME_DROP to test recovery mechanism resilience; IEEE/ASAM Auditor — ISO 26262 failure model taxonomy

injected_dropped_frame_indices.description: Semicolon-delimited list of targeted frame indices (e.g. '14;15;16'), or 'NONE' for clean bus
injected_dropped_frame_indices.source: Blind Auditor — corrected from ambiguous scalar count; IEEE/ASAM Auditor — spatial coordinates needed for burst pattern analysis

burst_length.description: Number of consecutive dropped frames in the burst (0 for clean, 1 for single, 3/8 for bursts)

channel_loss_rate_p.description: Applied channel loss probability for Monte Carlo sweeps (0.00 for deterministic scenarios)

payload_corruption_injected.description: Whether a bit-flip was injected into the payload to test Ascon-AEAD128 tag verification failure (separate from frame drop)
payload_corruption_injected.source: Blind Auditor — distinguishes dropped frame from corrupted-but-received frame

recovery_success.description: High-level session completion flag (True = payload reassembled and cryptographically verified)
recovery_success.source: All 3 auditors — retained as quick-filter boolean alongside detailed termination_status_code

recovery_rounds.description: Number of retransmission cycles executed (0 = clean first-pass, 1-3 for retry rounds)

retransmit_policy.description: Recovery mechanism type used by the protocol under test
retransmit_policy.source: IEEE/ASAM Auditor — distinguishes ISO-TP abort vs Castiglione restart vs 60/4 bitmap

nack_frames_issued_count.description: Total NACK or Flow Control frames transmitted across all retry rounds

nack_bitmaps_issued_hex.description: Semicolon-delimited hexadecimal 64-bit NACK bitmaps transmitted per round (e.g. '0x0000000000041000;0x0000000000040000'). Only applicable to SIXTY_FOUR_BLOCK protocol.
nack_bitmaps_issued_hex.source: Blind Auditor — captures per-round bitmap state; Repo Auditor — Cat 3.2 NACK frame is 16B with 8B bitmap (4B MISSING_BITMAP_0 + 4B MISSING_BITMAP_1)

round_1_requested_frames.description: Missing frames requested in Round 1 NACK
round_1_requested_frames.source: Blind Auditor — multi-round disambiguation is critical for protocol recovery dynamics analysis

round_1_recovered_frames.description: Retransmitted frames successfully received in Round 1

initial_frames_sent.description: Data frames transmitted in initial burst (41 for 60/4, 39 for ISO-TP, 12 for Castiglione native)

retransmitted_frames_count.description: Total data frames resent across all retry rounds

control_frames_count.description: Total control frames on wire (NACK + Flow Control + Restart NACK)

total_frames_on_wire.description: Total frames put on wire (initial + retransmit + control)

total_wire_bytes.description: Total physical bytes consumed on bus including frame overhead

end_to_end_latency_us.description: Total elapsed turnaround latency from Frame 0 Tx to complete payload assembly

nominal_clean_time_us.description: Theoretical or empirical baseline duration under clean bus (0% loss)
nominal_clean_time_us.source: Blind Auditor — needed to compute recovery_overhead

recovery_overhead_latency_us.description: Pure empirical time cost of fault recovery = end_to_end_latency - nominal_clean_time
recovery_overhead_latency_us.source: Blind Auditor — scope-unambiguous recovery latency definition

nack_turnaround_time_us.description: Delay from NACK Tx to receipt of first retransmitted frame
nack_turnaround_time_us.source: Blind Auditor — measures NACK protocol round-trip overhead
nack_turnaround_time_us.nullable_reason: Null when no NACK was issued (clean bus or full-abort protocol)

retry_exhaustion_flag.description: True if maximum retries (K_retry = 3) were exhausted without complete assembly

termination_status_code.description: Root-cause failure classification per ISO 26262 audit tree. Replaces ambiguous binary success/fail with actionable diagnostic codes.
termination_status_code.source: Blind Auditor — ISO 26262 failure taxonomy; IEEE/ASAM Auditor — iso26262_failure_classification field

iso26262_failure_classification.description: High-level ISO 26262 safety classification of the outcome
iso26262_failure_classification.source: IEEE/ASAM Auditor — ISO 26262-5 Annex D canonical fault model taxonomy

ftti_budget_us.description: Fault Tolerant Time Interval budget from HARA (default 50000 us = 50 ms for ASIL-D boot attestation)

ftti_violation_flag.description: True if end_to_end_latency exceeds ftti_budget (safety goal violation)
ftti_violation_flag.source: IEEE/ASAM Auditor — critical ASIL-D acceptance criterion

safety_state_achieved.description: Final system safety state after fault handling
safety_state_achieved.source: IEEE/ASAM Auditor — ISO 26262 safe state taxonomy
